title: Wall Street Trends: Hedge Funds and AI Stocks
description: Wall Street is seeing a shift in focus from AI stocks to value stocks, with hedge funds facing collateral demands and new funds emerging.

sections.heading: Hedge Funds and Collateral
paragraphs: According to Financial Times, hedge funds are facing demands to provide collateral as AI stocks experience a downturn.

sections.heading: New Hedge Fund Launch
paragraphs: Bloomberg.com reports that a hedge fund launched by an ex-OpenAI employee is seeking additional capital following losses.

sections.heading: Shift in Investment Style
paragraphs: Cabot Wealth Network notes that as the AI trade unwinds, there is a resurgence in the popularity of value stocks on Wall Street.

faq.q: Why are hedge funds facing collateral demands?
faq.a: According to Financial Times, this is due to the decline in AI stocks.

faq.q: What is the new hedge fund seeking capital for?
faq.a: Bloomberg.com states that the hedge fund, launched by an ex-OpenAI employee, is seeking capital after incurring losses.

faq.q: What type of stocks are gaining popularity on Wall Street?
faq.a: Cabot Wealth Network reports that value stocks are back in style as the AI trade unwinds.
